fusions.name: Pincer Ring
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away and closes the ring, which deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds.

fusions.name: No Way Out
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Inescapable] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped Bars
fusions.desc: Opens the cage on a wolf that fights for 15 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Gets Loose
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
